Owen goes to the museum on Tuesday. Owen and Grace are in the same class. The airport is not far from my home. What's more, is it ok if I open the window?
Grace often helps me with English. My friend Grace is very kind. The airport is my favorite place. For example, he wears shorts even in autumn.
Owen wants to visit Tokyo. Grace likes bread too. We talk about English a lot.
